run_upgrade_ssd_checkpoint: run the upgrade_ssd_version script to convert an old SSD checkpoint to the new version format
convert_ssd_state_dict_keys: convert SSD checkpoint state dict keys from the old naming scheme to the new neck and bbox_head structure
parse_ssd_config_string: parse an SSD model config string and validate that it uses the SSDHead bounding box head type
run_cli_convert_checkpoint: run the CLI tool with input and output file paths to upgrade an SSD model checkpoint version
refactor_convert_function: refactor the convert function to support additional key remapping rules for new SSD layer naming conventions
